Direct Testimony of Rachelle Anselmi on Behalf of myself.

Rachelle Anselmi on behalf of myself files this Direct Testimony, which is attached.
Rachelle Anselmi stipulates that this Direct Testimony can be treated by all parties as if
the answers were filed under oath. Rachelle Anselmi reserves the right to appoint legal
counsel at any time in these proceedings. Rachelle Anselmi files this testimony in
protest of the construction of any route utilizing the F8 link.

Respectfully,

 PERSONAL INFO:

What is your name?
A. My name is Rachelle Anselmi.
Have you filed a Motion to Intervene in this proceeding?
A. | have filed a Motion to Intervene in this proceeding.
What links and tracks are you representing today?
A. Links F8 and tracks 5244 and 5245.
Who are you testifying on behalf of today?
A. | am testifying on behalf of myself.
How is the property affected by the Bell County East to Big Hill 765kV transmission line
project proposed by Encor and LCRA TSC?
A. The transmission lines will traverse TWO of the 4 sides of my property.
What is the purpose of your testimony?
A. To ask that a better route with less homesteads be determined.
What routes do you oppose?
A. Any route that affects the homestead of a Texas resident.

PROPERTY DESCRIPTION:

Can you describe the affected property?

A. 35 acres in Williamson County with 100’s of live oaks, red oaks and other species
of native trees, as well as a wet weather creek that feeds Berry Creek Springs
and wetland areas. R635115 is 2 acres with a homestead, pool and shop built in
2022. R009863 is 33 acres.

Can you explain the current usage of the property?

A. The property is our homestead where we raise cattle, train labrador retrievers,
raise produce and enjoy the abundance of deer, turkey, squirrel, fox and a
number of other critters.

Can you include pictures with dates?
A. Yes.

Have they been altered?
A. No

Do the pictures accurately represent the views of the property?
A. Yes

IMPACT ON LAND AND USE:

How would the proposed transmission line interfere with your current land use?
A. We would not be able to continue to live in our home. The wildlife would no
longer be enjoyed and the noise would adversely affect our labradors.
Are any structures within 500 feet of the proposed routes?
A. Yes - my home.

Pg 2

 How would this affect the value of your land?
A. The property would lose more than half its value, if not more. As a Broker,
buyers do not want to live near high powered transmission lines. | see
homes sit on the market if they are anywhere near power lines.

Local Need and Cost:

Does this project provide a direct benefit to your local service area?
A. Not to my knowledge.

Do you believe this project will decrease your electric cost?
A. No, | believe it will increase the costs.

Environmental and Aesthetic Impacts:

What are your concerns about the local environment and wildlife?
A. The clearing of the trees will cause erosion and sediment into the wetlands
negatively affecting the water quality flowing into Berry Creek. The deer, turkey
and birds all use the trees as a habitat for birthing their young and protection.

RECREATION VALUES:

How will this transmission line affect your enjoyment of your property?

A. It will ruin the outdoor views, enjoyment of wildlife and reasons we purchased
and built where we did.

How will this transmission line affect your rural community values for your area?

A. The transmission lines will negatively affect the landscape and just about every
view in the area. This area is a heavily treed area of Williamson County and the
beauty of the outdoors will be ruined.

What is your recommendation to the Commission?

A. Place the lines in a rural, desolate area ~ not the fastest growing county in Texas.
Does this conclude your testimony?

A. Yes, at the current time.
